title: Assessment output — TEMPLATE
description: This is NOT the schema sent to the provider. It is the template that buildJudgeSchema(problem) instantiates per request, replacing the three ENUM_PLACEHOLDER values with that problem's own authored keys. That substitution is what makes naming an unauthored approach or insight structurally impossible rather than merely discouraged (FR-014, SC-004). Sent as response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { name: 'assessment', strict: true, schema: <this, instantiated> } }.

insights_missed.x-postcondition: insights_hit UNION insights_missed == every authored insight key, and the two are disjoint (FR-017). Repaired server-side and recorded as prompt drift if violated.

verdict.x-postcondition: Overridden by mapVerdict() when inconsistent with the classification; the mapped value wins and the discrepancy is recorded (FR-019).

confidence.description: 0-1. The RANGE lives in the prompt, not the schema — Groq's constrained decoding does not enforce numeric bounds. Clamped server-side.

feedback.description: At most 2 sentences, prompt-capped and server-truncated at 320 chars on a word boundary (FR-018). Length is NOT expressed in the schema.

x-not-in-schema.editorial: Attached server-side after a successful assessment (FR-022). The model never sees it and never produces it.
x-not-in-schema.followup_id: Dropped in v2. There is no scripted follow-up turn.
